build_batch_renderer: build a python module to initialize EnvBatchRenderer with a DictConfig and number of environments for batch rendering
render_post_step_observations: build a python module to call post_step on EnvBatchRenderer to render observations for all environments simultaneously
create_replay_renderer_cfg: build a python module to create a ReplayRendererConfiguration from config, num_envs, and sensor specifications
convert_float_to_rgb: build a python module to convert a float depth image ndarray to an RGB visualization image using _float_image_to_rgb_image
copy_rendered_output: build a python module to call copy_output_to_image on EnvBatchRenderer to get RGB images from the last post_step render
